tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The page ground, behind every card. Light: warm paper; dark: true black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, rows and inputs: the main reading ground.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Insets on a card: tonal buttons, segmented controls, chips when off, skeletons.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: A pressed or hovered tonal fill, one step past surface-2.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows, card edges on bg.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen: a chip, an input, inactive dots.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and titles on bg, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text (row values, helper copy) on bg, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Muted text (captions, kicks, timestamps, units) on bg and surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The primary action fill (the Log button, a primary .btn): ink-coloured, never a hue.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, focus rings, switches on, a tap-me floating pill. The sleep blue.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: A ghost button's hover, a field's focus halo.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: A good state: text and marks on surface. Always with a word or icon. Contrast on ok-soft in light: 4.38:1, below 4.5:1 for small text (kept as the app has it; use it at 15px semibold and up, or for marks).

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: The ground of a good banner or badge, with ok on it.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Something to look at: text and marks on surface. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: The ground of a warning banner or badge, with warn on it.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Danger and errors: text, a destructive row, a danger button's ink.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: The ground of an error banner and of .btn--danger, with bad on it.

tokens.name: s-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: an icon and its label.

tokens.name: s-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a group: buttons in a row, a chip row.

tokens.name: s-3
tokens.usage: Between a card's parts; a row's inner gap.

tokens.name: s-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the page gutter on a phone (page-pad).

tokens.name: s-5
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a sheet.

tokens.name: s-6
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: s-7
tokens.usage: Large section breaks.

tokens.name: s-8
tokens.usage: The largest gap: a hero's air.

tokens.name: r-s
tokens.usage: Small insets: an icon tile, a tag.

tokens.name: r-m
tokens.usage: Inputs, small cards, a floating sheet on a wide screen.

tokens.name: r-l
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, groups of rows, sheets' top corners.

tokens.name: r-full
tokens.usage: Pills and discs: every button, chip, segmented control and floating pill.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The 1px inner edge on cards and buttons that sit on bg, instead of a border.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: A card lifted a little: a toast, a menu.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Things over the page: sheets, the floating tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-float

tokens.usage: A button (.btn).

tokens.name: ctl-h-s
